description:
Property Reference: 2996761.

📍 Redland / BS6 Location
🚉 5-Min Walk to Redland or Clifton Down Station
🌳 5-Min Walk to the Downs
🏡 Enclosed Communal Garden
🚌 1-Min Walk to Bus Stop

£200 Off The First Month Rent!

A mezzanine studio flat is available on the ground floor, offered unfurnished, comprising an entrance hall, open-plan lounge/kitchen with appliances, a shower room, and access to a communal garden with patio and lawn. Suited to a single person or a couple.

Location is a standout feature. The flat sits in the heart of Redland, with a 5-minute walk to Redland or Clifton Down train station and a 5-minute walk to the Downs. Clifton itself is around a 15-minute walk, and the surrounding streets offer plenty of shops, restaurants and bars within walking distance. A bus stop is just a minute away, and the street itself is quiet. On-street permit parking is available.

  KEY FEATURES:

- Mezzanine studio flat, ground floor
- Open-plan lounge/kitchen with appliances
- Enclosed communal garden with patio & lawn
- Shower room
- Quiet street
- 5-min walk to Redland/Clifton Down Station
- 5-min walk to the Downs
- 1-min walk to bus stop
- On-street permit parking
